name: Hindustan Zinc Ltd
title: Hindustan Zinc Ltd - 500188 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record Q4 zinc cost of $903/t and 315 KT mined output drove EBITDA margin to 57%, but silver-led profit is commodity-driven and FY27 COP guidance rose to $975–1,000 with capex of $500–600M.

utilisation.quote: record-breaking fourth quarter with highest ever mined and refined metal production

capex.quote: Planned capital expenditure for FY27 is in the range of $500 million to $600 million towards announced growth projects.
